hero.headline: I build AI agents and software that hold up in production.
hero.lead: I design and build autonomous agents, process automation, web applications and document intelligence for startups, SMEs and enterprises. From idea to release, with one person accountable for the result.

owner.title: One accountable person
owner.text: You talk directly to the person who designs and writes the code, with no layers in between.

quality.title: Quality you can check
quality.text: Automated tests, accessibility and performance are checked before every release.

human.title: A person in the loop
human.text: Agents propose, a person decides at the critical steps, and every action is traced.

privacy.title: Privacy and security from the start
privacy.text: As little data as possible, secrets on the server only, integrations through official APIs.

services.title: What I can do for you
services.lead: Four areas that fit together, from process to software to documents. Each starts from a concrete problem, not from a technology.

demos.title: Try it in a simulation
demos.lead: Interactive demos with synthetic data: no real account connected and no personal data. They show how an agent reasons and where a person steps in.

process.title: From idea to release in four phases
process.lead: Measurable goals, a prototype evaluated on real cases, short development iterations and a launch with a proper handover.

finalCta.title: Have a process to automate or a product to build?
finalCta.body: Tell me the context. I will tell you honestly whether and how AI can help, even when the answer is that it is not needed, and what the next steps are.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Four areas with one thread running through them: solutions that work in everyday business, not just in a demo.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.body: Describe the situation in a few lines and I will help you work out which route makes the most sense.

work.title: Projects and demos

empty.title: Demos and case studies are coming
empty.body: This section will host interactive simulations and finished projects. Client projects appear only with the client's consent. If you want to talk about a case like yours, write to me.

cta.title: Have a similar case?
cta.body: Tell me what you do and what you need.

process.title: How I work
process.lead: Four phases, each with clear deliverables, so you always know where we are and what you will receive.

discover.title: Listening and discovery
discover.summary: Understanding the problem, the data available and what "it works" means for you.
discover.body: One or two conversations to clarify goals, users, technical and regulatory constraints and the systems already in use. I tell you straight away whether AI is the right choice or a simpler automation will do.

outputs.first: A one-page brief with goals and success criteria
outputs.second: A map of the data and systems involved
outputs.third: The main risks and the open questions

prototype.title: Prototype and evaluation
prototype.summary: A first working result, measured on real examples, before committing a large budget.
prototype.body: I build a prototype aimed at the most uncertain point and evaluate it on a set of concrete cases. If it does not hold up, we find out immediately and cheaply.

outputs.second: An evaluation on real cases, with the results
outputs.third: A project proposal with scope, timing and costs

build.title: Development in short iterations
build.summary: Frequent releases, automated tests and continuous feedback.
build.body: I build in short cycles, with features you can see at every step. Automated tests, accessibility and security checks are part of the work, not a final phase.

outputs.first: Working, tested software in a test environment

launch.title: Launch and improvement
launch.body: A controlled release, monitoring of quality and costs, and training for the people who will use the system. Code and documentation are yours; further development and support remain available.

outputs.first: The system in production, with monitoring
outputs.second: Source code and documentation handed over
outputs.third: A plan for further development and support

measurable.title: Measurable goals
measurable.text: We agree at the start how we will know it works, and we check it on real cases.

transparent.title: Transparency
transparent.text: I tell you what the AI does, where it can be wrong and where a person steps in.

handover.title: Proper handover
handover.text: Code, documentation and access stay with you: the system must be able to live without me.

cta.title: Want to know if this way of working suits you?
cta.body: A first conversation is there to clarify goals and constraints, with no commitment.

cta.title: Let us see if I can help
cta.body: Tell me about your project: I reply personally.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.lead: Tell me about your project or the process you want to automate. A few lines are enough: I reply personally to understand goals and constraints and propose next steps.
contact.informal: Nothing formal is needed: write as you would to a colleague.

context.title: The context
context.text: Who you are, what you do and which process or product you have in mind.

goal.title: The goal
goal.text: What you would like to achieve and how you will know it worked.

constraints.title: The constraints
constraints.text: Timing, a rough budget, the systems and data you already have, privacy requirements.

reply.title: I reply personally
reply.text: I read carefully and write back to understand the case better.

call.title: We talk
call.text: If it makes sense, we set up a first conversation to clarify goals and constraints.

proposal.title: You get the next steps
proposal.text: I propose how to proceed: a prototype, a project or, if it is the right answer, the choice to do nothing.
